extraction.Name: Susie Yellow Horse
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent to her land but took it for the reason that she was told that if she did not, and keep the taxes up, that she would lose the land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her land to Stockmen's National Bank, Rushville. Nebr. for $300.00; sold it to Peter Pourier for $1800.00, the purchaser to pay the mortgage
extraction.Buyer: Peter Pourier for $1800.00, the purchaser to pay the mortgage
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she was about to lose the land for Taxes so she sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband who does common labor for a living, making about $200.00 per year
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in poor health; has no land, no home and is living on the allotment of her brother; has not received any aid from the Government, State or County since her patent was issued; document appears to reference dependents but text is cut off ('Deponent, further state depending on her for suppor')
